dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Presence of one distinct, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Narrow, sharp pale edges are highly prominent along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast white patch with an elliptical footprint is visible on the lateral side of the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and indistinct transition with no clear linear boundary separating the crown and the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly conspicuous white outer rectrices visible along the lateral edges of the long, dark-gray tail.
